nom: Clinique All About Clean Rinse-Off Foaming Face Cleanser

avis.texte: I've gotten several of these as free gifts with purchase and keep trying it but it's horrible! It leaves a film on my skin and it doesn't clean! When I dry my face, the towel shows the residual makeup! All About Clean liquid face soap never did that and left my skin feeling nice.
This is a great cleanser. It is very creamy, removes makeup and oils, and leaves your face so soft.

I have been using the 1oz wash of this for like 2 months. you need to wet your face put an actual pea size or less on your wet hands and bam it will wash your face and next perfectly. this product lasts a long time making it really worth the money. plus my have has been DRY for years. it was oily and large pores and I never moisturized or had been constant. this product and their moisture surge has my skin looking amazing already. you honestly can't go wrong. I was hesitant to try to a "luxurious" brand over a dove or St Ives... but this is exactly what you want for your skin. and it's so simple! love it! Their rep Nicole M, in FL really sold me on it. the best discovery for me.

avis.titre: Used to be good, changed formula
avis.texte: I used to buy this all the time and the last time I purchased it, it was horrible. Drying, not even coming close to cleansing, smelled different, felt different and overall seemed 100% worse!

I love the Clinique facial wash. But was disappointed in the shipping. It was just stuck in an envelope and mailed out. It wasn't put in a plastic bag if it leaked. When I opened it up, it had leaked all over the bag and I had a mess to clean up. Just a suggestion.
This product states to avoid eyes, this is true. If a little gets near my eyes, my eyes feel irritated . Also, this product states its fragrance free but this cleanser has a subtle unpleasant smell.
A little more cleansing power than the 3 step program. Good to remove makeup without greasy makeup remover. Good for summer.

This was recommended by Clinique Rep at the Ulta Store. She gave me a sample. After the first use, I was sold. Fragrance free. You need such a small amount that the product will last a long time. I was using All About Clean liquid facial cleanser, which I liked also. Right now I think this one is my go to. I love the feel of the product as well as my skin after I cleanse my face.

avis.titre: Not for Mature DRY Skin - Ulta employees need more education
avis.texte: Love Clinique products, used many throughout the last 30 years. The workers in Ulta need some education when recommending products for DRY MATURE SKIN. I will be returning it.

I have used this cleanser and I wouldn't recommend it to someone with dry or dry combinate skin type. It dries the skin too much and after rinsing it off it feels like you still have soap stains on your skin. I didn't like the feeling
Perfect face cleanser. Foams and cleans face leaving it feeling soft and moisturized.
I've been using this for years, is very gentle to the skin, subtle smell and feels like silk over the skin. One small amount is good for your face, hence it lasts for a long time.

I have always had oily/combination skin and have struggled with acne my entire life, since going into perimenopause my skin became very oily and I was getting bad cystic acne on the bottom half of my face. I've tried so many skincare products(have probably tried most of the stuff in Ulta haha), I also cannot use anything with salicylic acid because it breaks me out worse. I found this controls the oil and have been using it consistently for about 10 months now and I only get a pimple every now and then. I do also use the clinique toner(one in the pink bottle) and a few other face washes alongside it, but I always start and finish with this one! if I do have a breakout, I use panoxyl(only on breakout area). I also use la roche posay and cosrx skincare products. If my skin is dry I make sure I follow up with clinique moisture surge moisturizer. I also use the clinique all about clean cleansing and exfoliating wash once a week. I love clinique skincare products! I introduced this to my best friend and it also works for her skin as well!
I have been using this for years. I am now in my "mature" years and it still works great. It cleans without stripping, has no scent, and let skin feeling soft.

Used this product before bed and woke up to my face burning. My face was red with hives and my lips felt tight. By the end of the day the hives and redness went away but my skin felt rough and my lips scabbed over.
I had the trial size and actually loved it. I then purchased a full size. Now that I am using it consistently, it is very drying. My skin feels tight after use.
This face wash made my skin soooooo dry! Not the right product for me.

This thick cleanser feels very gentle, soft and smooth on the skin. I got a mini size with an order, and it's size makes it convenient for travel. Since a small drop goes a long way, I think it will still last a long time!
I really love this cleaning foam. It's creamy and lives a really good sensation on your skin.

I got it in a holiday kit and honestly, I really like it. A little definitely goes a long way and it foams up a lot. I like how it doesnt leave my skin dry but it does leave a slight tug; which to me just proces its very clean. I have combo oily but my bf has dry skin and he really liked how it felt his skin feel moisturized.

I didn't realize how much I loved this product until I ran out. It leaves my skin squeaky clean. I have combo/oily skin and my skin loves this cleanser. I usually use this first and then follow with a facial cleanser. When I worked for Clinique, I would recommend this as a makeup cleanser.

avis.titre: For oily skin - not dry or combination-dry
avis.texte: I purchased this product thinking it was "Clinique Rinse Off Foaming Cleanser", a gentle mousse cleanser that Clinique includes in its sample packages. I was expecting a gentle cleanser similar to the "facial soap - mild" cleansing bar Clinique used to make for skin types 1 and 2. I used it once and learned that it is definitely not intended for dry skin - I had a rash on my face for a week! I'm a long-time user of Clinique products (44 years), but I've never experienced this sort of product mis-match before, especially one so costly and with no recourse.
After receiving a sample, I have added this rinse-off to my mid day face cleaning. Only takes a small amount to get a good size lather. Gentle formula is perfect for my sensitive dry skin.

avis.titre: Skin is left clean and soft
avis.texte: I have combination skin and in the T-Zone my skin is oily (forehead and nose) and my cheeks are often dry. I love the fact that the product nourishes my skin and cares for it. To remove eye make up I recommend, 'Take The Day Off™ Makeup Remover For Lids, Lashes & Lips' before using this product. The reason is your eyes are sensitive and 'Take The Day Off" gives your eyes the TLC it needs. Pro - -Skin is soft and clean -Product removes dirt and oil and does not over dry -Fragrance free -You will feel beautiful - I love the Pink tube as it it helps me remember which product to buy Con -Don't squeeze too hard or a lot comes out My face feels fresh when I use this product. I have tried many products in my life and feel like I found gold with this one. Your face is the first thing that people see and I feel like I can finally step out with confidence. My skin is very sensitive and I adore the fact that it does not cause me to break out as it does not have heavy perfumes. This product gets an A plus.

I started using this when it was newly introduced. I loved it. Then, I introduce it with my four daughters and they loved it too. Its really good, the best cleanser ever. We will keep buying this I hope Clinique will not discontinue this product, its very convenient to use and very affordable as well during sale season.

Once again, I received Clinique's All About Clean Rinse-off Foaming Face Cleanser from my bag of Clinique goodies from a friend this summer. Except for the pink, the bottle was in yellow. This foaming cleanser worked well to cleanse my face with the foaming lotion. You can feel it work wonders for your face when you spread it in a lather all over your skin.
The product is creamy but washes off clean without stripping. It doesn't foam as advertised, but not disappointed!
This cleanser is so great. My face is squeaky clean after using it. And I love it that the tube is pink !

avis.titre: You need to avoid the eye area with this product
avis.texte: I received this product in a kit. Reading the information about it let me know that you have to avoid your eye area when using this product. How does one wash your face without wetting your entire face, the eye area included? I can't figure it out and I am not going to risk hurting my eyes. Just a heads up...

This is such a wonderful way to rinse off the days makeup while not over drying your skin. Y face feels moisturized and clean. I love that I don't have to worry about a reaction to it. Just wonderful feeling skin.

Ive seen reviews stating there was residue left over…PEASE don't forget that whatever cleanser you use, you ALWAYS need to "double cleanse". First round gets off makeup, second round really CLEANS the face of most impurities. I'm super happy with this so far!

I love all my other clinique products but this does not meet the standard. A little goes a long way and it feels super silky smooth while washing (both pros) but it leaves a thin layer of film on my fash after washing, like a cheap bodywash leaves you sticky. My face feels tight, but not clean and refreshed tight. It feels sticky and unwashed. You HAVE to use a moisturizer after. I'll stick with my $8 pink grapefruit face wash.

I like that you don't need a lot to lather for your face. Sadly I still see some residual makeup on the cotton pad from applying the clarifying lotion afterwards but not terribly. This also doesn't appear to dry the skin out.

After using this face wash I follow up with the clarifying lotion/toner. The amount of dirt that appears on the cotton pad tells me that the wash isn't working. This happens even when I don't wear makeup.
So happy these now come in travel size!! Love this face wash.

avis.titre: I have used this for the past 3 years and will continue to
avis.texte: Great foaming cleanser and it leaves my skin feeling refreshed and hydrated but not in an oily way. I use it for shaving too and I never get razor bumps. Love this!!

avis.titre: A mild foaming facewash.  Great for sensitive skin.
avis.texte: I have been using All About Clean foaming facewash for years. It is gentle and cleans well.

ok so i read some reviews and comments before buying thinking that this would be safe for my sensitive, combination, acne prone skin. WRONG. so wrong. it strips and i mean strips your face. i was so itchy afterwards, red flag number one. red flag number two?? my face the next morning was so so and i mean SO swollen, itchy, red and covered in splotchy hives. like i have never seen my skin react like this to any products. i am currently attempting to recover from this episode and am horrified by cliniques product, especially to whom they are marketing this too. maybe i shouldve read more comments, or maybe i should've done a tester patch before using but seriously guys do your research and read the ingredients (there is SLS in this product) and dont have a severe reaction like me. but honestly 0/5 stars.
Ive used this facewash for years i love how gebtle it is and how it removes my makeup effectively.
Ive used this facewash for years i love how gebtle it is and how it removes my makeup effectively.

This facial soap is perfect for my sensitive skin. It cleans thoroughly without leaving my face feeling dry or tight. The formula is really gentle, fragrance-free, and easy to rinse off. I am using this cleanser for years and I'm very happy with that

It's the best value of any cleanser Ive tried. Highly recommend.
I love this cleanser, it can make my face clean and can remove sunscreen!

After just 2 days using this cleanser, I broke out terribly. That hasn't happened in 30+ yrs. I was using Clinique's All about clean oily skin formula but it left my skin dry so I switched to this one. Time to find another product

If you are looking for a soap that is going to clean your face....this is it! Your face is literally Squeaky Clean....I love it

I started using a sample of this cleaner and noticed the next day immediate results! It does not dry my face out or make it feel tight like most cleansers..

I sadly have to toss every convenient travel-sized sample received from FGWP straight into the trash. I have tried over and over to like this cleanser and make it work, but it absolutely burns my eyes so badly each and every time. Love Clinique, but this formula is dangerous.

I tried a sample of this face cleanser and I absolutely love it so I bought the full size product. Its creamy and non drying. You only have to use a little bit to wash your face so it goes a long way. I will continue to use this product.
I found this great cleanser with a free sample. It makes my skin feel very clean but not drying. You only need to use a very small amount for full face coverage and cleaning.
I needed a new nightly cleanser to double cleanse, so I decided to try this out. The price is great, it lathers and cleans great, but it dried out my skin so much.

avis.titre: The foam of cleanliness and shine

The Clinique foaming face cleanser is so rich and creamy. It feels wonderful on my face and helps with moisturizing as well as cleaning. I won't use anything else.
Have been using this product for over a year and still absolutely love it. You can feel the clean and it is not harsh on my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Great cleanser, left face so smooth!

What a game changer! This cleanser left no residue, my skin felt very smooth to the touch, and was not tight at all! A little goes a long way, too, so this will last for a while! Once again, Clinique scores a home run! I will definitely be purchasing more of this product!
made my skin burn and itch and dry out! i love clinique but this product is not it

The rinse is very important to me, and this one is the best! I have mature skin, not really oily, and there is absolutely NO residue feeling left - doesn't leave my skin tight either. I've used the liquid facial soap extra mild and it isn't half as good as this cleanser. Please, KEEP IT AROUND. Thank you!

avis.titre: Best cleanser ever! I will continue to use it!
avis.texte: This product is my favorite facial cleanser. It washes off my makeup and cleans my skin. I'm a life long Clinique user, and it is my all-time favorite!

I love this foaming face cleanser! It leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean. I have sensitive skin and I've never had any problems with the All About Clean Rinse- Off Foaming Face Cleanser or any other Clinique products. Definitely recommend!!
I enjoy using Clinique products. This product is the BEST foaming face cleanser I have ever used. Leaves your skin feeling clean and refreshed.

avis.titre: Leaves my skin feeling so clean!
avis.texte: Leaves my face feeling so clean with zero makeup residue left behind. Doesn't dry my face out. Absolutely love this product!

Bought my usual cleanser in Dubai and it's consistent as always. My combination skin looks and feel flawless.
This foaming cleanser is my favorite one! It has super soft formula that removes all the makeup very easily!

avis.titre: only combo/oily skin... removed high end make up well
avis.texte: This stuff clean your face and im talking about crazy clean to the point your skin will feel like its very drying but it is not. its drying but its not drying irritating if you know what I mean. Best to use a very tiny bit than your usual amount.
Not only is pretty Pink, but it's gentle enough on my delicate skin.

avis.titre: Not the same product as shown online
avis.texte: This rinse-off foaming cleanser is not the same product I ordered online. It states "dry combination to oily" instead of "combination oily to oily," the ingredients are different, and it behaves differently. Now I have to go to the store, which defeats the purpose of ordering it online!

I've tried this for a few days on two separate occasions and both times it caused significant acne on my chin. That's not even a normal breakout zone for me. I thought it could be something else the first time but after stopping, my face clearing up for a few weeks, and trying it again BOOM. Fool me once. The texture feels nice and you don't need much to cover your entire face. It smells like oatmeal in the most medicinal way.

avis.titre: Another favorite falls off my must-repurchase list
avis.texte: Until the last year, I rarely bothered to read Clinique skincare ingredient labels, as I could trust everything to be gentle and effective, even if I accidentally picked up a product designed for skin type 3 or higher. Like this one! This cleanser was my type 2 skin's favorite summertime evening wash for more than a decade. However, after the "All About Clean" prefix was added, the formula and performance changed, and not for the better. This cleanser used to provide the most exquisite, cushiony, cloud-thick foam that I could use all over my face (eyelids, mouth, around nose), and my skin would feel and BE clean afterward, needing only a touch of DDMG around the perimeter of my face. In this version, if the flaccid foam gets anywhere near my mucous membranes, it stings and BURNS. Even worse, it no longer removes all traces of sunscreen or makeup and my face feels uncomfortably tight afterward. I am disappointed that yet another Clinique product is being added to my ever-growing "don't repurchase" list. It feels as if Clinique is going the way of Prescriptives in an attempt to draw in first-time customers but forgetting about those who have shopped with you for up to half a century. By all means, continue to innovate, it's why we love you. But PLEASE also continue to offer best-selling products without needing to continually reinvent them. Both loyal and new customers will continue to flock to counters and to the web store.

My favorite Clinique product! The reason I feel compelled to write a review is that I keep reading how this product is for oily skin. Well, this dry-skinned mama LOVES the smoothness, the easy rinsing, and the way my skin feels so fresh and supple after use, never taut or dry. My skin loves this stuff! In fact, I may stock up, since Clinique seems to be discontinuing lots of good products, recently! Kidding/Not kidding...
Awesome product! I've been using it for years and love it! Great cleanser for all year long throughout different seasons for my skin.
This is such an amazing face wash!!! It feels so creamy and lathers so well even caught my fiancé using it and he is a manly man lol definitely worth the price.

it is a game-changer, leaving my skin feeling fresh and clean.
